signOutConfirm.title: Sign out and erase this device's data?
signOutConfirm.noServerCopy: This account's hosts, keys and snippets are stored only on this device. Signing out erases them and they cannot be recovered.
signOutConfirm.unsynced: Sync is paused or could not reach the server, so recent changes on this device may not be saved there. Signing out erases this device's copy.

deleteAccount.actionSub: Permanently delete your Voltius cloud account and its data
deleteAccount.title: Delete your Voltius account?
deleteAccount.message: This permanently deletes your cloud account, your encrypted vault and all cloud sync data from the Voltius server. You also leave any team you are a member of. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.deviceNote: This device is then signed out and its local copy of your hosts, keys and snippets is erased, as with Sign out. Copies on your other devices are not removed remotely.
deleteAccount.subscriptionNote: Your subscription is cancelled along with your account: it will not renew and you will not be charged again.
deleteAccount.deleted: Your Voltius account has been deleted.
deleteAccount.failed: Could not delete your account (error {{status}}). Try again later, or contact support.
deleteAccount.ownsTeamWithMembers: You are the only Owner of a team that still has other members ({{teams}}). Make another member an Owner, remove the members or delete the team, then try again.
deleteAccount.subscriptionCancelFailed: Your subscription could not be cancelled, so your account was not deleted. Try again in a few minutes, or contact support.

trialExpiredModal.title: Your Pro trial has ended
trialExpiredModal.subtitle: These three stop working today:
trialExpiredModal.freeNote: Local vault, audit logs and GitHub Gist sync stay free, forever.
trialExpiredModal.teamsPrompt: Working with others? Try Teams free for {{days}} days (card required).

tagFilter.emptyDescription: Tags help you filter your hosts. You can add a tag when editing a host.
tagFilter.deleteTagBody_one: This will remove the tag from {{count}} host. The hosts themselves won't be deleted.
tagFilter.deleteTagBody_other: This will remove the tag from {{count}} hosts. The hosts themselves won't be deleted.

vaultUnavailable.note: The vault could not be read, so stored secrets are not shown here. Leave a field empty to keep what is saved; typing a new value replaces it.

teamCredentials.unavailable: Stored credentials for this team vault could not be loaded, so hosts that need a saved password, key, or passphrase will fail to connect. Ask a vault administrator to grant your role access to the vault's secrets.

vaultBackups.title: Vault backups
vaultBackups.description: Vault files set aside when they could not be opened. Restoring one puts it back as your vault and keeps the current one as a new backup — nothing is deleted.
vaultBackups.empty: No vault backups on this device.
vaultBackups.warn: This backup becomes your vault. It opens with the master password that was in use when it was made, so you will be signed out and asked to unlock.
vaultBackups.warnReadable: Your current vault can be read. Restoring replaces it — it is kept as a new backup, and you will be signed out and asked to unlock with the password that made the restored file.
vaultBackups.restoredToast: Backup restored. Your previous vault was kept as {{file}}.
